measurement_limitations: Equal-B admission ratios describe finite controlled policies on one nonexclusive CPU.
All policies pay the same two-task acquisition; cheaper alternative acquisition policies remain untested.
Final-parent siblings are admitted locally and do not add canonical chain growth or network TPS.
Structure-specialized is a fixed known algorithm mapping, not a proven fastest producer.
Only identity-matched prefixes under uncensored budget exhaustion permit paired ratios.
Overshoot and native observers stay charged; posthoc reconstruction adds no credited tickets.
The changed source and v2 namespace do not reinterpret the previous 32-attempt experiment.
Full strategy CPU includes local observers, receiving admission and deliberate duplicate checking; these are measured harness costs, not enforced attacker-miner costs.
5,322 counts retained proof records, including 336 original winners repeated in posthoc reconstruction; it is not a distinct-ticket total.
Thirty main jobs end at height 5 and chainwork 10; counterfactual siblings and different jobs cannot be added as serial growth.
Hot and cold name arithmetic-preparation policies, not guaranteed processor-cache states.
The zero/hot/3102 negative observation is retained; stage localization is posthoc and does not establish its cause.
